topic: Introduction to guided missiles and definition
syllabus_extract: Introduction to guided missiles and definition. Classifications of guided missiles –SAM, AAM, SSM & ASM.
specific_objectives: 23.1.1.1 Trainee will be able the basic knowledge of air craft armaments.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Nil specified; default to L & Ds and IB, PDF
intro_questions: What is the primary difference between a guided missile and an unguided rocket?
Can you name one example of an aircraft armament?
What does the acronym SAM stand for in missile terminology?

topics: Distinction between guided and unguided weapons
Role of guidance in target acquisition
development.content:
Definition of guided missile
Basic principle of guidance systems
Distinction between guided and unguided weapons
Role of guidance in target acquisition
Importance of guidance accuracy

Classification of guided missiles
Surface to Air Missile (SAM)
Air to Air Missile (AAM)
Surface to Surface Missile (SSM)
Air to Surface Missile (ASM)

Operational characteristics of SAM
Operational characteristics of AAM
Operational characteristics of SSM
Operational characteristics of ASM
Comparison of missile types

summary_questions: Explain the difference between SAM and AAM based on their launch and target platforms.
How does the guidance system affect the operational effectiveness of an ASM?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the sub-assemblies of a guided missile to be discussed in LP 05.

pft_rows.syllabus: Guided missiles sub-assemblies, airframe, propulsion unit, guidance unit, control unit, warhead unit etc; Demonstration in weapon demo room.
